fyb.metaTitle: Find Your Base: Match Cities to Your Life | Nomad Spin
fyb.metaDescription: Set your budget, climate, internet and safety needs, weight what matters, and see which cities fit. Every score is explained.
fyb.h1: Tell us what matters. See what fits.
fyb.intro: {count} cities, ranked against your needs. Move a slider and the list reorders. Open any result to see exactly why it scored what it did.
fyb.weights.title: What matters most
fyb.weights.hint: Weights are shares of the score. The starting mix is a suggestion, not a finding.
fyb.strict.label: Only cities that meet my budget and minimums
fyb.strict.hint: Off: a city that misses one still appears, with a lower score and a warning.
fyb.dataset.label: Hide cities with estimated records
fyb.dataset.hint: Some city records are estimates that nobody has checked by hand.
fyb.noWeights.title: Every weight is at zero
fyb.noWeights.body: Give at least one criterion some weight and the ranking comes back.
fyb.empty.title: No cities in that selection
fyb.empty.minimums_one: {count} cities miss your budget or a minimum. Relax one, or turn off the strict filter.
fyb.empty.minimums_other: {count} cities miss your budget or a minimum. Relax one, or turn off the strict filter.
fyb.empty.other: Add a region or show cities with estimated records.
fyb.disclaimer: A score is a fit to the numbers you entered, not a verdict on a place. Visa length depends on your passport, and climate uses an annual average. <link>How scoring works</link>.
fyb.card.estimated: Estimated record: these figures have not been checked by hand.
fyb.card.caption: Score breakdown for {city}
cmp.metaTitle: Compare Cities for Remote Work | Nomad Spin
cmp.metaDescription: Put two to four cities side by side: monthly cost, internet, safety, visa length, climate and community. Share the comparison with one link.
cmp.h1: Side by side, on what matters.
cmp.intro: Pick two to four cities. Each row shows who leads and where the data runs out. There is no overall winner: that depends on what you care about.
cmp.picker.label: Add a city to compare
cmp.picker.full: Remove a city to add another
cmp.empty.title: Start with a pair
cmp.empty.body: Search above, or open one of these.
cmp.one.title: Add one more city to compare with {city}
cmp.one.body: Search above. You can add up to four.
cmp.delta: {cheaper} costs ${amount} less per month than {pricier} ({percent}% lower).
cmp.how.title: How to read this
cmp.how.leads: One city is strictly best on that row. Ties and preference rows have no leader.
cmp.how.noData: “No data” means the dataset has no figure for that city. It is never filled in.
cmp.how.estimates: Figures tagged <estimate></estimate> or <formula></formula> are not hand-checked values.
cmp.how.visa: Visa rows depend on your passport. Confirm with an official source before you book.
cmp.cta.title: Not sure which criteria matter most?
cmp.cta.body: Find Your Base ranks every city against your budget, climate and work needs, with weights you control.
